original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Harden CentOS 9 server
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    ssh_port: 22
    fail2ban_maxretry: 5
    fail2ban_bantime: 3600
    audit_log_format: ENRICHED
    audit_max_log_file: 8
    audit_max_log_file_action: rotate
    audit_space_left_action: email
    audit_action_mail_acct: root
    audit_admin_space_left_action: halt
    password_minlen: 14
    password_minclass: 4
    password_maxrepeat: 3
    password_difok: 3
    password_remember: 5

  tasks:
    - name: Update all packages
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name: '*'
        state: latest
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Install required packages
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - fail2ban
          - audit
          - audit-libs
          - libpwquality
          - policycoreutils-python-utils
        state: present

    - name: Configure SSH to disable root login
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^#?PermitRootLogin'
        line: 'PermitRootLogin no'
        validate: 'sshd -t -f %s'
      notify: restart sshd

    - name: Ensure SSH password authentication is enabled (for non-root users)
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^#?PasswordAuthentication'
        line: 'PasswordAuthentication yes'
        validate: 'sshd -t -f %s'
      notify: restart sshd

    - name: Configure password complexity via pwquality
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*{{ item.param }}'
        line: '{{ item.param }} = {{ item.value }}'
        create: yes
      loop:
        - { param: 'minlen', value: '{{ password_minlen }}' }
        - { param: 'minclass', value: '{{ password_minclass }}' }
        - { param: 'maxrepeat', value: '{{ password_maxrepeat }}' }
        - { param: 'difok', value: '{{ password_difok }}' }
      notify: update pam password quality

    - name: Enforce password history
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/pam.d/system-auth
        regexp: '^password\s+sufficient\s+pam_unix.so'
        line: 'password    sufficient    pam_unix.so sha512 shadow nullok try_first_pass use_authtok remember={{ password_remember }}'
        backrefs: yes
      notify: update pam password quality

    - name: Configure fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: fail2ban-local.j2
        dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      notify: restart fail2ban

    - name: Enable and start fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        enabled: yes
        state: started

    - name: Configure auditd rules
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: auditd-rules.j2
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
      notify: restart auditd

    - name: Configure auditd.conf
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*{{ item.param }}'
        line: '{{ item.param }} = {{ item.value }}'
      loop:
        - { param: 'log_format', value: '{{ audit_log_format }}' }
        - { param: 'max_log_file', value: '{{ audit_max_log_file }}' }
        - { param: 'max_log_file_action', value: '{{ audit_max_log_file_action }}' }
        - { param: 'space_left_action', value: '{{ audit_space_left_action }}' }
        - { param: 'action_mail_acct', value: '{{ audit_action_mail_acct }}' }
        - { param: 'admin_space_left_action', value: '{{ audit_admin_space_left_action }}' }
      notify: restart auditd

    - name: Enable and start auditd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: auditd
        enabled: yes
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

    - name: update pam password quality
      ansible.builtin.command: /usr/sbin/authconfig --updateall
      changed_when: false

    - name: restart fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted
